staging_sql:
{% set column_names = 
    dbt_utils.get_filtered_columns_in_relation( source('synthea', 'conditions') ) 
%}


WITH cte_conditions_lower AS (

    SELECT
        {{ lowercase_columns(column_names) }}
    FROM {{ source('synthea','conditions') }}
)

, cte_conditions_rename AS (

    SELECT
        {{ adapter.quote("start") }} AS condition_start_date
        , {{ adapter.quote("stop") }} AS condition_stop_date
        , patient AS patient_id
        , encounter AS encounter_id
        , code AS condition_code
        , description AS condition_description
    FROM cte_conditions_lower

)

SELECT *
FROM cte_conditions_rename

hint:
- Timestamps are split into <column>_date (MM/DD/YYYY) and <column>_time (HH:MM:SS), both in UTC.
- Date columns are text written DD-Mon-YYYY (03-Sep-1942).
- code_display is the code, ' | ', then the description: split at the first ' | '.
- All other columns keep the acquirer's source column names in lower case.
